reply: good question <@465912833352138768>, and it's a real thing in the game: when a war ends, the loser has 20% of every resource taken by the winner (30% if they have Looting Teams), consumer goods included. celess, open your news page and look for a war-ended / "Spoils of war" entry from the last few days, it lists exactly what was taken. if it's there, that's a big part of the missing goods. if there's nothing there, it's something else and i keep looking
